svg.title: Econometrica — capability and feature map
svg.text: a local econometrics workbench for asset pricing and market efficiency
The one invariant — LLMs never compute statistics. They select from a registry of 37 typed, versioned tools; the tools compute.
Validation tiers: single · critic · consensus Providers: Ollama · Anthropic · OpenAI · Gemini · NVIDIA NIM
Plus a Quant Coder that writes code in an OS-sandboxed process when no tool fits — off by default, and its results are marked unvalidated everywhere they surface.
ECONOMETRICS CORE — 37 TYPED TOOLS, FIVE FAMILIES

Beside them: a deterministic diagnostics engine (normality, heteroskedasticity, autocorrelation, ARCH effects, structural breaks) and executable preconditions that decline a fit the data cannot support.
A tab per chart, plus Narrative,
PNG and SVG from the live chart.
Spans for latency, run steps for
tokens and cost. No number is
HOW IT AVOIDS MAKING NUMBERS UP
they select from the registry; the tools compute
Tools refuse work the data cannot support
Prose is checked against the results
an unmatched number withholds the whole narration
Generated data and generated code are marked
in the manifest, the banner and the printout
Built and tested, not yet reachable from a run: web search · document retrieval over pgvector · the MCP tool allowlist
1417 backend tests · 320 frontend · 6 end-to-end · Python + FastAPI · React + TypeScript · Postgres, TimescaleDB, pgvector
